name: Airwindows
description: An effect chain of up to 8 Airwindows effects (510 effects in 22 categories, from Airwindows Consolidated). Audio from a Live track comes in over Ableton Link Audio, runs through the chain, and goes back to Live as the Link channel Airwindows. An app of Push Hack Home (Shift + Help): the chain, a category browser and a page of parameters for each effect, on Push's screen and encoders. The web page shows and edits the same chain. Needs push-audio-loopback (Link mode, with inputs), push-manager + push-display for the Push editor.
author: joman66
